definitions.meaning: To make right, rectify, correct, amend

quotations.old_english: Gif hé ðonne (after punishment) swá ne béte and rihtlǽce, hé sý of ðam ealdorscype áworpen
Se ðe ǽr ðysum misdyde, ðæt hé hit georne gebéte and rihtlǽce hine sylfne
Úton wé nú ǽlces yfeles geswícan and rihtlǽcan ús sylfe on eallan þingan
Æfter ðam ðe hé sylf geriht wearþ hé began georne mynstera wíde geond his cyneríce tó rihtlǽcynne
quotations.english: after his own life was ordered aright, he began to set the monasteries in order

source_text: rihtlǽcan; p. -lǽhte To make right, rectify, correct, amend :-- Gif hé ðonne (after punishment) swá ne béte and rihtlǽce, hé sý of ðam ealdorscype áworpen, R. Ben. 46, 19. Se ðe ǽr ðysum misdyde, ðæt hé hit georne gebéte and rihtlǽce hine sylfne, Wulfst. 277, 2. Úton wé nú ǽlces yfeles geswícan and rihtlǽcan ús sylfe on eallan þingan, 174, 30. Æfter ðam ðe hé sylf geriht wearþ hé began georne mynstera wíde geond his cyneríce tó rihtlǽcynne after his own life was ordered aright, he began to set the monasteries in order, Lchdm. iii. 440, 2. v. ge-rihtlǽcan.
